title: Bulk register fleet vehicles with a common expiry date
summary: Learn about applying to register a fleet of vehicles with a common expiry date (CED), meaning all registrations will renew at the same time.
intro:
If you have a fleet of vehicles, you can apply to register them with a common expiry date (CED). This means the registrations on the vehicles will be due for renewal at the same time.
